title: Remove repeats across the whole course
statement: Expect knowledge drafted from several sources to overlap, and remove repeats across the whole course, not only within a unit, before people review it.
example: People rejected 160 of 2,087 generated links across nine units, most of them with a note that the content repeated another, such as 'already covered'.
detail: An AP history knowledge-schema pipeline drafts facts from several sources, and in one unit's consolidation audit the model marked 857 of 1,356 drafted facts 'Yes' under 'Overlap Notes' (`downloads/Knowledge Schema Generator - AP USH Unit 2.xlsx`). Its redundancy step checks a topic's facts only against earlier topics in the same unit. In the course's human checks, kept in its knowledge-schema tracking spreadsheet, 160 of 2,087 generated links were marked 'No', most with a repeat note, and people also removed nodes already covered in another unit.
against: Overlap varies by unit: in the Unit 7 workbook's consolidation audit, 109 of 597 rows are marked 'Yes' (`downloads/Knowledge Schema Generator - UNIT 7.xlsx`). The Unit 2 flags are the model's own consolidation notes and mostly mark relatedness ('related to' appears 255 times), not duplicates.
